about: Which events on a person's life list (`lifeOf`, src/core2/person-life.ts) the Journal tells as which of its rows (src/director/data/journal-rows.json), by the event's life and what and, where two records share them, the record that wrote it. A pair not here is not told by the Journal. Work and the places a person began (born, came to the county, a partner's home, a school started) are read in src/director/journal.ts by their own shapes, because each sentence there is built from several events (what a job paid against the one before, how long it lasted). `weighed` says the director's moment for the same record, when it has one, lends the entry its weight (who else was in it, how much it grew since); the entry exists because the list holds the event. A move (`moved`) is told on the day of the list's move; the director's own moment of that day (the household changed) lends its weight and is not told as well.
